report.title: Tank sloshing CFD study with OpenFOAM: first-mode frequency against linear theory

code.install: none for the eval; OpenFOAM ESI v2312 (Linux) only to rerun the CFD

inputs.description: Archived free-decay frequencies at h/L 0.15, 0.30, 0.50, 0.70 and the five-mesh, three-timestep study at h/L 0.30
OpenFOAM ESI v2312 with interFoam, to rerun the CFD cases (optional)

missing_data.what: A Linux machine with OpenFOAM ESI v2312, to rerun the free-decay cases
missing_data.why: The eval reads the archived CFD outputs; it does not run a CFD solver.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Say whether you have OpenFOAM v2312; each case took 520 to 660 s on our workstation.
missing_data.effect: Without it the CFD side of the comparison is taken from the archive.

cannot_do: Rerun the CFD inside an AI chat: it needs OpenFOAM on Linux and about 10 minutes per case.
Say anything about 3D or violent sloshing: the study covers the planar first mode of a 2D tank at small amplitude.
Give impact pressures: frequency, phase and run-up are the quantities checked.
